products.title: Military Range
products.body_html:
From Service to the Fairway - At Clamp Golf Company, we believe some materials deserve a second life. Our Military Headcovers are handcrafted using genuine decommissioned military uniforms, clothing and equipment donated to us by Military vs Cancer, transforming pieces with their own history into completely unique golf headcovers.

Supporting Military vs Cancer 

Your Purchase Makes a Difference - Every purchase from our Military Collection helps us continue supporting Military vs Cancer. The more covers we sell, the more military materials we can repurpose, allowing the collaboration to grow and enabling us to make further donations to the charity. By choosing one of these headcovers, you're not only giving a piece of military history a new life — you're helping us give something back too.

Materials - Each headcover is created using genuine donated military materials, carefully selected, cut and repurposed by our team here in Yorkshire. Due to the nature of the materials, colours, camouflage patterns, stitching, markings, pockets, patches and signs of previous use may vary between covers. These characteristics are deliberately retained wherever possible, giving every headcover its own individual character and history.

One of a Kind - No two Military Headcovers will ever be exactly the same. The material used to create your cover has lived a life before reaching our workshop, with natural variations and signs of wear forming part of the story behind each piece.

Optional Military Badges - Make your Military Headcover even more personal with our range of optional embroidered badges. Choose from designs including Serving, Veteran, Reservist, national flags, the poppy, Military vs Cancer and Clamp Golf designs, allowing you to create a cover that represents your service, connection or individual story. Each badge is embroidered in-house and carefully applied to your chosen headcover, making an already unique piece even more personal. Just add the number of badges you would like to the cart, then let us know what badges you would like.

Durable Stitching - The construction of our golf headcovers is marked by exceptional attention to detail. We use nylon bonded thread - one of the toughest threads available - to provide robust, resilient stitching. This ensures your headcover withstands the test of time and maintains its shape and structure, regardless of the conditions on the course.

Inner Lining - A soft inner lining of fleece provides optimal protection to your clubs. This plush lining guards against scratches and dents, helping to keep your equipment protected both on and off the course.

Fit - All of our headcovers are designed and made to fit all makes and models.

Craftsmanship - Every Military Headcover is handcrafted from start to finish in our Yorkshire workshop. From carefully selecting and cutting each piece of original military material to sewing and finishing the final cover, every piece is individually made by our in-house team.

By repurposing these materials, we're able to preserve a small piece of their history while creating something that can continue its journey for years to come.

From service to the fairway.

products.title: Premium Bamboo Tees
products.body_html:
Our premium tees come in packs of 50 & 100, measure at 85mm. We use bamboo for a number of reasons;

  • Bamboo is a fast growing and a naturally renewable tree-like grass. It requires little maintenance to farm as it doesn't need any pesticides or herbicides and very little water to grow.
  • One of the biggest environmental benefits of bamboo is its ability to absorb carbon dioxide and produce oxygen. Bamboo also self-regenerates using its own roots to replenish the grass after harvest.
  • Bamboo is clocked as the fastest growing plant on earth. Some species have been measured to grow over 4 feet in 24 hours.
  • A pole of bamboo can regenerate to its full mass in just six months. It can be continuously re-harvested every 3 years without causing damage to the plant system and surrounding environment. During the time it takes to regenerate, the bamboo plants root system states intact.
  • Continuous harvesting of this woody grass every 2-7 years actually improves the overall health of the plant.

products.body_html:
Introducing the Brigantes golf headcovers - a range of golf headcovers that pays homage to the rich history and culture of the Brigantes tribe, who once inhabited the northern regions of England, Including Yorkshire, where these headcovers are crafted.

Crafted from genuine leather, sourced locally from Leeds, England which was also inhabited by various Celtic tribes, including the Brigantes, each headcover is a testament to the region's rich heritage and craftsmanship.

The Brigantes headcovers are designed with a unique v-cut at the bottom of each cover and embroidered numbers add to the antique look and feel.

The Brigantes golf headcovers are available in a range of colors, including dark green, red, blue, brown, and grey, each representing a different aspect of the Brigantes culture and history.

But who were the Brigantes, and why are they so important? The Brigantes were a powerful tribe that dominated northern England for centuries, long before the arrival of the Romans in Britain. Their territory covered a vast area, including modern-day Yorkshire, Lancashire, and Cumbria.

The Brigantes were known for their fierce independence and military prowess, and they were skilled in agriculture, metalworking, and trade. They had their own language and customs, and their culture was shaped by their connections with other Celtic tribes in the region.

The Brigantes were also known for their resistance against Roman occupation. In the early years of the Roman conquest, they allied with the Romans against other tribes but later rebelled against Roman rule, leading to a long and bloody conflict.

Eburacum is the Latin name for modern-day York, which was once the capital of the Brigantes tribe
